reading:
The judges love what Folio became in 14a. It went from costume to the clearest system in heat b: first for system (8.1) and in the soul lens's top four, with 6 top fours and 6 promise votes, mean 7.78 linked (+0.94 on its carried design). They credit: one head row per page (P-number, Fraunces title, a light Fraunces figure with its unit, one green primary); every list set as contents lines (lamp · number · name · dotted leader · state); every list in time hung from a rail with one lit NOW; Fraunces over Plex as the best pairing in the heat; Fraunces figure-setting (oldstyle day numerals, drive times with a raised h, the month's lit today); the radar drawing plans by their day beside the NOW rail; the scanlined glass greeting with only 'on' haloed and a VT323 status line with a cursor (soul 8: "the tube is alive and says a fact"); Status rebuilt as contents lines; and 0 small targets.

What held it back, by how many lenses said it:
(1) Page numbers in the nav ('Home 100') and in 'see p400 Plans': system, interaction, type, usability and the skeptic. They are codes the family has to decode, and they crowd every key.
(2) The title. 'What's on for us?' asks the page to show what is on, so it fails as the box's label (feedback, interaction, skeptic, and the title notes from type and usability). It was also set in a greyed Fraunces with a weak lit word (soul, skeptic).
(3) Synthesized 13px small caps, a fourth voice, and two cross-reference devices: style, type, skeptic and system.
(4) Home is still a boxed dashboard mosaic. The lower household is a busy 3+2 grid, and Home needs one headline region (system, style, skeptic, feedback: "pull the cells' borders back to hairlines and let the rails do the grouping").
(5) The box sits inside the tube with a lit placeholder frame: system wants the field slate until typed in, interaction wants the box out of the tube.
(6) Status's 13px rule heads are too quiet, and its spend tube has no live element (soul, style, system, type).
(7) Restaurants, Memory, Family and Wishes still use card cells (soul, system, usability).
(8) Phone: the status line wraps, 'Send where I am' takes its own row, and the starters fall below the first screen. The focused select has no ring.
Feedback also asked for "a little more VT323 or terminal type in the page heads", so the almanac stays a terminal's magazine.

What would make it win: keep the system the judges named the clearest, and spend this round on its five fixes (nav numbers out, a title that invites, three faces, Home unboxed into one headline region with one contents list, Status hierarchy). Then take the other camp's best devices that give Folio more lit data without more glare. Waypoint's readout strip took for interaction and usability. Departures' and Trued's starter hints closed the "what will this do" gap. Trued's square-root meter closed the needle-at-zero failed reach. Pocket's quick-add was usability's fastest add. Each must be rebuilt as a teletext magazine device (Fastext keys, contents lines, a slide rule on the glass, the header row), so the line keeps its signature while the field converges. The owner's latest ask, to bring the phosphor back, is met by the light Folio already places well: the halo'd lit word on scanlined glass with a cursor, tubes at full strength, breathing lamps, a row afterglow that shows, and a lit Row 0 page header. Grounded section inks (wheat, sky, sea, clay, amber for late) keep their share so the colour does not drain.

briefs.name: Folio, Fastext
briefs.hypothesis: Railed Contents lost points only on fixable things: codes in the nav, a title that asks to be shown, a boxed Home mosaic, a fourth voice, quiet Status heads. It never lost on its idea, and the system lens already ranked it first. This cross keeps the idea (a teletext magazine's numbered pages, contents lines, rails with one lit NOW, Fraunces figures) and makes the numbering honest by putting it where teletext put it: a lit Row 0 page header on the glass, and a contents page. Home becomes one cased headline (the title on scanlined glass, the box under it, and a Fastext row of four live, grounded-colour keys) over unboxed sections hung from rule heads and rails. Each graft is rebuilt as a videotex device: Waypoint's readout strip as Fastext keys, Departures' and Trued's starter hints as contents lines, Trued's square-root meter as a slide rule on the spend glass, Pocket's quick-add as the head line of To do's rail. So it gains the other camp's best usability and lit data while looking more like itself, not more like the field. That should lift interaction, usability, type and the skeptic (its four lowest, 6.8-7.7) without costing the soul and system marks it earned.
briefs.brief:
Start from x14a-folio-cross: copy its sheet.css, templates/ and static/.

THE WHOLE SITE
1. Bar (base.html): delete the page-number suffix spans from every nav key ('Home 100' becomes 'Home'). Keep the icons, sentence-case words, and the current key's section-ink cap with a small breathing lamp (E20). Page numbers now live only in Row 0, in each page's head and in Home's Contents list.
2. Row 0, the teletext header line (new macro row0(number, name) in _ui.html, called at the top of every inner page's head: Vera, Ideas, Restaurants, Plans list and month, To do, Wishes, Memory, Family, Status, Settings and its sections). It is a single line, 2rem tall, as wide as the head (max 76rem), on dark glass: background #050807, the E14 scanlines at 0.5 opacity, 1px #232a26 border, radius 4px. Set it in VT323 1.25rem at --phosphor-dim (about 70% phosphor). The page number is white-hot: P300 in #6dff9c with an E13 bloom and a hot core. Then 'FamilyDB · Ideas' dim. At the right end the date the page was drawn, 'Fri 2 Oct', from the date Home already gets. Every clause is a nowrap span. Below 30rem only 'P300 · Fri 2 Oct' shows. It is never a green-filled bar and carries no figure the head row already says. aria-hidden, since the h1 says the page. Remove the P-number from the head row itself, because Row 0 now carries it.
3. Type: three faces with jobs. Fraunces is for titles, rule heads and figures only. IBM Plex Sans is for everything read and pressed. VT323 is on glass only (tubes, Row 0, the Fastext figures stay Fraunces). Delete both font-synthesis: small-caps declarations (sheet.css ~111 and ~140). Replace every font-variant-caps: all-small-caps (labels, .unit, .u, .colheads, .said-by, table th, dl.facts dt, legend, .kind, .cell-key, .now-word, .leaf-day .dm, etc.; the group at ~2059) with a token --label: 600 0.75rem/1.2 var(--sans), text-transform: uppercase, letter-spacing: 0.06em, colour --label #a9b4af. These are real capitals, not scaled ones. One cross-reference device everywhere: Plex italic, sentence case, 0.875rem, --dim ('lands in Plans', 'Vera files it'). Delete every 'see pNNN'.
4. Scale, written in :root: label 12 caps, small 15, body 17, item 17/600, rule head 22 Fraunces 600, figure 30 Fraunces 300 (opsz auto), page title 32 Fraunces 600, Home title 40 Fraunces 600. Tabular lining figures in columns, oldstyle in the rails' day numerals.
5. Light (from phosphor_kit.md). Lit word: E1 two-layer halo plus a hot core. Tubes: E12-E14 at full strength (glow, screenGlow and topGlow stay 1.0). Lamps: E20. Focus: E5, which every select must now show, including the details strip on Ideas and the From select. Row afterglow (ledger T2-15): every contents line, task row, idea row and plan row lights a 2px #6dff9c edge on its left on :hover and :focus-within, plus a 6% phosphor breath, then lets go over --fade 1.5s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.3,1) so the 120ms and 380ms stills catch it. Nothing else glows.

HOME (home.html, _ask.html)
Grid: a 30rem left column and a 1fr right column, gap 2.5rem.
Left, the one headline region: Vera's case (E12, a 2px bezel with a hairline lip, not a thick case).
- Case head line: her screen mark, 'Vera' in Fraunces 600 1.25rem, and the date in --label caps.
- The glass, sized to its content (align-self:start), scanlined, lit from below (E7). It holds only the title, 'Tell Vera what's on.', in Fraunces 600 2.5rem/1.05 at full bone #eceee8. 'on.' is the lit run, with the full stop inside it, in #6dff9c with E1 and a hot core, and an E15 block cursor breathing after it. No dimmed off-words: soul and the skeptic asked for full ink. The h1 holds a <label for=text>.
- Directly under the glass, on the case's deck, the box out of the tube (interaction, system): a plain slate field, background #0c100e, 1px #323a36 edge, radius 6px, 3 rows, Plex 17px bone for typed words. The placeholder is in --faint, with no lit frame and no '>' glyph until focus. On focus the edge turns #6dff9c and E4 box-glow comes on.
- One control row: From select, mic, Send (the green primary, E3). On desktop 'Send where I am' sits on the same row, right of From. On the phone it shares the From row and Send drops beneath at full width.
- The ways to start: three contents lines, unboxed, 48px, hairline separators. Each has a 1.5rem VT323 key numeral (1 2 3) in a small dark glass square at --phosphor-dim, the words in Plex 500, a dotted leader, then the hint with the page's icon in its ink and 'lands in Plans' / 'lands in To do' / 'lands in Ideas' in Plex italic. Under them, right-aligned, 'Continue with Vera →', with no page number.
- Fastext row, the case's foot. Four equal keys (grid 4 × 1fr, min-height 3.5rem, on the bezel #272b2b, 1px #363c3c edges) that are the teletext remote's coloured keys in grounded inks: a 4px × 1.5rem cap across each key's top in its ink, the label in Plex 600 15px, and the figure in Fraunces 300 1.75rem. 'Plans 4' (sky #9ccdf8) goes to Plans. 'To do 4' (sea #83d5d4) goes to To do. 'Late 3' (amber #eaa76b, figure in amber words with a small amber lamp; never an amber outline) goes to To do?status=late. 'Ideas 12' (wheat #d6c491) goes to Ideas. These are whole 44px+ links with hover afterglow. They replace the old VT323 status line's facts, so that line is deleted, and the phone's two-line wrap goes with it. On the phone the keys sit 2 × 2.
- Below the case, Ideas, unboxed: a rule head (Fraunces 22/600 'Ideas', dotted leader, figure '12' in Fraunces 300 30px wheat with the unit 'SAVED' in --label caps, then '+ Add an idea' as a text link at the right), a 1px #232a26 hairline, and four lately-added contents lines (kind ring icon, name Plex 600, for-whom --dim, kind word in its ink). The Restaurants line moves to Contents.
Right column:
- 'Finish setting up' strip, first: keep the amber 3px left edge and the words, sentence case, no box fill.
- Plans, unboxed under the same rule head ('Plans', leader, '4' in sky, 'COMING', 'All plans →'): the radar and its NOW rail of Fraunces day numerals as they are now. The cell border, top cap and surface fill are removed, and the rail does the grouping (feedback).
- To do, unboxed under its rule head ('To do', leader, '4 OPEN · 3 late' with late as an amber link): the NOW rail, WHO/DUE heads, square ticks, as now.
Full width at the foot: Contents. Rule head 'Contents' with figure '6 more pages'. Then two columns (each max 36rem, gap 3rem) of one contents line per row, 48px. Each line: lamp, folio number in Plex 500 13px --faint tabular, name in Plex 600 17px, dotted leader capped at 22rem, state right-aligned. Rows: 310 Restaurants · 2 to try; 600 Wishes · Maya 0 · Theo 0; 700 Memory · Tell Vera something; 800 Family · 4 people; 900 Status · Telegram off · Calendar off, with steel ring lamps; 990 Settings · 1 needs a look, in amber words with an amber lamp. The 3+2 .hh mosaic and its borders are deleted.
Phone (≤ 40rem): case, then box, Send, Fastext 2 × 2, starters, then Plans with the next plan on the first or second screen, then To do, Ideas, Contents.

INNER PAGES
- Every head: Row 0, then the head row (title in Fraunces 32/600, light figure plus caps unit, one green primary on the right), then the lede.
- To do (tasks.html), Pocket's quick-add rebuilt as the head line of the rail. The first row hanging from the NOW rail is a form posting to edits.add_task: a square-tick-sized '+' well, a field 'What needs doing…' (Plex 17, slate, data-dictate), the mic, and the green 'Add' as the page's one primary. Under it, 'More: who, when, a reminder' (Plex italic link) to the full form. Remove the head row's 'Add something to do' button, so there is one primary. The filter keys (Open, Late 3, Done, Cancelled, All) and Search sit above the list as now. Keep the tally tube on the left.
- Status (status.html): every group's rule head goes to the Home step. Fraunces 22/600 'Who answers', a leader, then the figure '3' in Fraunces 300 30px plus 'OF 4 ON'. So the first screen has Home's hierarchy. The spend glass becomes Trued's square-root meter, rebuilt as a horizontal slide rule on the glass, sized to content. The scale is the square root of the share of the limit, with tick labels in VT323 at $0.01, $0.10, $0.50, $1.00 and $2.00 (the limit, a dashed end stop). A ghost cursor (dashed, --phosphor-dim) sits at the usual day ($0.04 over 30 days), and the lit cursor (a 2px #6dff9c line with a hot core and a halo) at today, so $0.00 still reads as a measurement. The figure '$0.00' sits above it in VT323 2.6rem. Words for screen readers. Contents lines stay as they are.
- Restaurants, Memory, Family, Wishes (restaurants.html, memory.html, family.html, wishes.html): replace the card cells with the head row and contents lines (lamp or initial, name, leader, state or figure), with forms below them under a rule head. One kind of list looks one way everywhere.
- Ideas, Plans month, Chat, Settings: keep them as built, add Row 0, and take the labels to the new caps token. On Chat, give the From select the focus ring.
briefs.borrows:
Its own judges' fixes, most cited first:
(a) Page numbers out of the nav and out of 'see pNNN', kept only in page heads and a contents index: system, interaction, type, usability, skeptic.
(b) A title that invites, with full bone ink and real weight on the lit word: feedback, interaction, skeptic, soul, plus the titles notes from type and usability.
(c) Three faces, real capitals in place of synthesized small caps, and one cross-reference device: style, type, system, skeptic.
(d) Home's mosaic made one headline region plus one contents list, with hairlines and rails doing the grouping: system, style, skeptic, feedback.
(e) The box out of the tube as a slate field until typed in: interaction, system.
(f) Status rule heads at the 22px Fraunces step with a figure, and a live element on the spend glass: soul, style, system, type.
(g) Restaurants, Memory, Family and Wishes onto contents lines: soul, system, usability.
(h) Phone status line to one line, 'Send where I am' on the From row, a focus ring on the select: usability, soul.
(i) More terminal type in the heads: feedback, answered by Row 0.

briefs.avoids:
The line keeps its contents line, the rails with one lit NOW, Fraunces over Plex, the figure-setting, the radar beside the rail, the month's lit today, the tally tube, Settings' numbered contents, 0 small targets and the scanlined glass greeting.

It answers each criticism like this:
- 'Home 100' noise and 'see p400' codes: gone from the nav and starters, kept honestly in Row 0, the head and the Contents page.
- A title that asks to be shown: replaced by an imperative naming Vera.
- The dim greyed Fraunces: full bone ink.
- Synthesized small caps and the fourth voice: real 12px Plex caps, three faces, one italic cross-reference.
- The boxed dashboard mosaic and the busy 3+2 household: one cased headline region, unboxed rule-head sections, one two-column Contents list.
- The placeholder glowing in a lit frame inside the tube: a slate field out of the tube that lights only on focus.
- Status's quiet heads and dead spend glass: 22px Fraunces heads with figures, and a lit cursor on a square-root rule with a ghost.
- Card cells on four pages: contents lines everywhere.
- The phone wrap and the lone 'Send where I am' row: the status line is replaced by Fastext keys, and the checkbox shares the From row.
- The select with no ring: E5 focus everywhere.
- The almanac drifting from the terminal: Row 0 and the Fastext keys put VT323 and lit glass back in every head.

It avoids the crossing rounds' traps:
- No graft keeps its source's look: Fastext keys, not Waypoint's mono strip; a slide rule, not Trued's dial; contents lines, not Departures' enamel keys.
- No stretched containers: the glass and the spend glass are sized to content.
- No colour drain: the Fastext caps and figures carry sky, sea, wheat and amber, and the contents lamps carry section inks.
- No amber outlines: amber on words, one lamp and the setup edge only.
- No rails on unsequenced lists: Ideas stays unrailed, and the rule head groups it.
- No inverted-green chips.
- No title shared with another line.

What it gives up to make room: the box inside the tube and its green frame, the long VT323 status line (its facts move to the Fastext keys), the P-numbers in the bar and in the head row (they move to Row 0), the 'Add something to do' head button on To do (the quick-add's Add is the one primary), the cell boxes, top caps and surface fills on Home, the household's 3+2 mosaic, and the synthesized small-caps voice.
briefs.title: "Tell Vera what's *on*." The lit run is 'on.', with the full stop inside it. It is set in Fraunces 600 at 40px, at full bone ink on Vera's scanlined glass, with E1's two-layer halo and a hot core on 'on.' and a breathing block cursor after it. The title is untried in the tour and the crossing rounds. It keeps the line's own lit word: 'on' is also the tube's power word, which soul and style called the most phosphor title in heat b. It turns the failed question into an invitation, as the 14a feedback, interaction and skeptic notes and the titles lessons asked for Folio ('an invitation that keeps its glass status line and one short lit word'). It says FamilyDB's job: the family tells Vera, by name, whatever is on for them (a weekend, an appointment, a reminder, an idea, a wish), and she plans it. It cannot be read as a request to display anything, it works as the box's <label>, it fits one phone line at 2rem, and the lit word sits where the eye stops. It differs from every other line's title, including 'Give Vera something to plan.', 'Tell Vera what to plan.' and 'What needs a plan?'.
